name: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
source:
Talewarden is a weird west adventure visual novel. Restore time on a planet where the sun never sets as you explore locations, talk, romance, and bond with your companions. Find the source of the voice in your head and discover why you all fell here from different worlds.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3250420/Talewarden_Riders_of_the_New_Day/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Talewarden》是一部奇怪的西部冒险视觉小说。当你探索地点、交谈、浪漫并与同伴建立联系时，在一个日不落的星球上恢复时间。找到你脑海中声音的来源，并找出为什么你们都从不同的世界跌落到这里。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3250420/Talewarden_Riders_of_the_New_Day/]Steam[/url]]
